# test_remove_duplicates.py
import pytest

from your_module import remove_duplicates  # Replace with the actual module name


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("input_list", "expected"),
    [
        pytest.param([1, 2, 1, 3, 2, 4], [1, 2, 3, 4], id="integers"),
        pytest.param(["a", "b", "a", "c", "b"], ["a", "b", "c"], id="strings"),
        pytest.param(
            [1, "1", (1, 2), 1, (1, 2), "1"],
            [1, "1", (1, 2)],
            id="mixed-hashable-types",
        ),
        pytest.param([3, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1], [3, 1, 2], id="preserves-order"),
    ],
)
def test_remove_duplicates_happy_path(input_list, expected):
    assert remove_duplicates(input_list) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("input_list", "expected"),
    [
        pytest.param([], [], id="empty-list"),
        pytest.param([42], [42], id="single-item"),
        pytest.param([7, 7, 7], [7], id="all-duplicates"),
        pytest.param([1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 3], id="already-unique"),
        pytest.param([None, None, "x", None], [None, "x"], id="none-values"),
        pytest.param([1, True, 0, False], [1, 0], id="bools-equal-ints"),
    ],
)
def test_remove_duplicates_edge_cases(input_list, expected):
    assert remove_duplicates(input_list) == expected


def test_remove_duplicates_does_not_mutate_input_list():
    input_list = [1, 2, 1, 3]
    original = input_list.copy()

    result = remove_duplicates(input_list)

    assert input_list == original
    assert result is not input_list


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "input_list",
    [
        pytest.param([[1], [1]], id="list-items-are-unhashable"),
        pytest.param([{"a": 1}], id="dict-item-is-unhashable"),
        pytest.param([{1, 2}], id="set-item-is-unhashable"),
        pytest.param([1, [2], 3], id="unhashable-item-after-valid-items"),
    ],
)
def test_remove_duplicates_raises_type_error_for_unhashable_items(input_list):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="unhashable type"):
        remove_duplicates(input_list)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "bad_input",
    [
        pytest.param(None, id="none"),
        pytest.param(123, id="integer"),
        pytest.param(object(), id="plain-object"),
    ],
)
def test_remove_duplicates_raises_type_error_for_non_iterable_input(bad_input):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        remove_duplicates(bad_input)
